profile.name: Rushank Bansal
profile.headline:
Rushank
Bansal.
profile.intro: Computer science at VIT Chennai. Building with machine learning, computer vision, and the web.
profile.bio: I’m a second-year Computer Science student at VIT Chennai. I learn by building: connecting physical sensors to machine learning, training models, and turning them into tools people can use. I enjoy the entire journey from the first question to a working application.
profile.contactText: I’d love to help figure it out. Let’s talk about projects, ideas, and opportunities to build something useful.

projects.title: PrecipyTech
projects.summary: From physical sensors to rainfall predictions.
projects.description: A sensor-based machine learning system that predicts rainfall using readings collected from multiple physical sensors. An independent first-year project connecting classroom concepts with a real data source.
bullets: Collected and preprocessed physical sensor readings.
Trained a scikit-learn model to generate rainfall predictions.
Built the pipeline from data collection through inference.

projects.title: Fact-Checker
projects.summary: A second look at the sentences we read.
projects.description: A Chrome extension that evaluates whether a selected sentence is likely true or false, powered by a custom-trained classification model and a Python backend. Model predictions are probabilistic and are not a substitute for source verification.
bullets: Trained a classification model on a labeled dataset.
Connected the browser extension to a Python backend.
Separated the backend and extension so the model can evolve independently.

projects.title: DevPilot
projects.summary: A shorter path from code issue to correction.
projects.description: An in-IDE assistant built with a teammate. The tool uses the NVIDIA AI API for real-time code analysis and automatic fix suggestions while a developer types.
bullets: Collaborated on the design and implementation in a two-person team.
Integrated the NVIDIA AI API for code analysis.
Contributed to the automatic code-correction workflow.

projects.title: Gesture Recognition
projects.summary: Teaching a camera to understand a gesture.
projects.description: A live hand-gesture recognition system using webcam input, MediaPipe hand-landmark tracking, and a trained classification model.
bullets: Collected gesture examples for model training.
Trained a model to classify gestures from a live webcam feed.
projects.imageAlt: Typographic project study for Gesture Recognition

projects.title: Gym Management
projects.description: A website to store and manage gym membership data, connecting a web interface with a MySQL database.
bullets: Built the website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Used MySQL to store membership information.
projects.imageAlt: Typographic project study for Gym Management

projects.title: Backend REST API
projects.summary: The connection behind a web application.
projects.description: A REST API built with Node.js and Express to serve a web application.
bullets: Implemented backend API routes using Node.js and Express.
projects.imageAlt: Typographic project study for Backend REST API
